article.title: When protests serve the West, they are “revolutions”. When they challenge it, they are “violent riots”
article.author: Editor
article.content: What matters is whose power is threatened, whose interests are served and whether the existing capitalist order is being challenged or strengthened. After all, democracy has never been independent of class interests. The post When protests serve the West, they are “revolutions”. When they challenge it, they are “violent riots” appeared first on MR Online .
